name: What is involved in a tub-to-shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms your existing bathtub space into a modern, functional shower. This typically involves removing the old tub, and often includes replacing wall surrounds, installing a new shower base or pan, shower fixtures, and potentially new plumbing. We focus on maximizing space and updating the aesthetic, ensuring a seamless integration with your current bathroom design. The process is designed to be efficient, minimizing disruption to your home while delivering a significant upgrade to your bathroom's utility and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion involves removing the old tub and installing a new shower base, walls, and fixtures in its place.
